summary: This diff is purely additive: four new AI-review YAML documents (ddd/ux/workflow/ai-governance), four registration scripts that upsert their findings into the existing audit_findings SQLite table, a close-out script that appends a status/evidence block to the phase-plan YAML using an anchor-based text replacement (avoiding a reformatting round-trip), and the corresponding appended evidence in AUDITOR_ENGINE_PHASE_PLAN_2026-07-24.yaml. No production application code, migrations, schema, auth, or .github/workflows/** files are touched, matching tier1's additive/isolated criteria. The registration scripts use parameterized SQL (no injection risk), an flock-based write lock for concurrent-write safety, and idempotent ON CONFLICT upserts that preserve first_seen_ts, following the same pattern as the prior Phase 4 script. Spot-checking several cited findings (crm-service.ts scoreLead/createChainedTask, approval-workflow-service.ts decideApprovalStep, erp-procurement-workflow-service.ts submitAuctionBid) against the real compliance-tracker source confirmed the referenced functions, line numbers, and described behavior are genuine rather than fabricated. The close-out script's guard clauses (required-file existence check, anchor-text match, duplicate-close-out check) are sound defensive measures against silently corrupting the plan file.
